state: Goal `core-uri-1-2`. Its floor check `dossier-core-uri-1-2` names 12 `Core\Uri` members. `buildQuery`, `compareTo`, `decodeComponent`, `encodeComponent`, `encodeFormValue` and `decodeFormValue` have all their feature proofs. `parse`, `parseQuery`, `host`, `port`, `path` and `fragment` still owe some. `Core\Uri` has its class card, so no member owes the `help` proof. `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Uri'` measures each figure that is missing or stale, and it runs after `bun nv verify` has rebuilt the binary. A change to a card alone left the other figures current. `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Uri' --no-perf` lists what each member still owes. An instance reader (`host`, `port`, `path`, `fragment`) is not credited by a call, so it owes a `.nvst` case and a Rust `#[test]` that carry its `covers:` marker (`tests: 0 of 2 cases`).

items.text: **`Core\Uri::host`** — owes tests (a `covers:` marker on one `.nvst` case and one Rust test), examples, hostile, perf. **`Core\Uri::port`** — the same owed list, and its card `PORT_DOC`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs:857`
**`Core\Uri::path`** and **`Core\Uri::fragment`** — the same owed list, and their cards. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs:866`

backlog: `Core\Uri::parse` and `Core\Uri::parseQuery` owe examples, hostile, perf and a Rust `covers:` marker — the last two members of this goal's floor check. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`.
